from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
H,W=a.shape
# local equalization via tiled CLAHE
def clahe(a, tiles=8, clip=3.0):
    out=np.zeros_like(a)
    th,tw=H//tiles,W//tiles
    maps=np.zeros((tiles,tiles,256),np.float32)
    for i in range(tiles):
        for j in range(tiles):
            t=a[i*th:(i+1)*th, j*tw:(j+1)*tw]
            hist,_=np.histogram(t,bins=256,range=(0,256))
            clipn=clip*hist.mean()
            hist=np.minimum(hist,clipn)
            # redistribute
            excess=hist.sum()
            cdf=np.cumsum(hist)
            cdf=(cdf-cdf.min())/((t.size-cdf.min())+1e-6)
            maps[i,j]=cdf
    # bilinear-ish: for simplicity use nearest tile then blend
    for i in range(tiles):
        for j in range(tiles):
            t=a[i*th:(i+1)*th, j*tw:(j+1)*tw]
            idx=np.clip(t.astype(int),0,255)
            out[i*th:(i+1)*th, j*tw:(j+1)*tw]=maps[i,j][idx]*255
    return out
o=clahe(a,8,3.0)
Image.fromarray(o.astype(np.uint8)).save('clahe.png')
print('done')
